description.zh: 任务结果回调URL，目前仅支持HTTP地址。
description.en: The callback URL for job results. Only HTTP URLs are supported.
A description of the watermark information.

description.zh:
待添加水印的媒体文件OSS地址，目前仅支持视频文件，JSON对象。详细信息请参见[Input详情](~~29253~~)。

> - OSS的地域需要与当前MPS所在地域保持一致。
  
- Bucket：输入文件OSS Bucket名称。
- Location：OSS所在地域，必须和MPS服务所在地域一致。
- Object：待检测OSS Object。
description.en:
The location of the input media object in OSS, specified as a JSON object. Currently, only video files are supported. For more information, see [Input](~~29253~~).

> - The OSS bucket must be in the same region as MPS.

- `Bucket`: The name of the input OSS bucket.

- `Location`: The region of the OSS bucket. This must be the same as the MPS region.

- `Object`: The object in the OSS bucket to be processed.

description.zh: 水印级别，取值0/1/2，表示嵌入通道，0u，1uv，2yuv。
description.en: The watermark embedding channel. Valid values: 0 (U channel), 1 (UV channels), and 2 (YUV channels).

description.zh:
文件输出OSS地址，JSON对象。

> - OSS的地域需要与当前MPS所在地域保持一致。
description.en:
The location of the output object in OSS, specified as a JSON object.

> - The OSS bucket must be in the same region as MPS.

description.zh:
水印任务参数，JSONString。目前支持设置参数如下：

- algoType：算法类型，默认值为v1。
  - v1：长视频版权水印，仅支持3min以上的。
  - v2：短视频版权水印。
description.en:
Additional parameters for the watermarking job, specified as a JSON string. The following parameter is supported:

- `algoType`: The algorithm type. Default value: `v1`.

  - `v1`: The copyright watermark algorithm for long-form video. It supports only videos that are 3 minutes or longer.

  - `v2`: The copyright watermark algorithm for short-form video.

description.zh: 水印嵌入开始时间，单位为秒，不填写默认为0。
description.en: The start time for embedding the watermark, in seconds. If this parameter is not specified, the default value is 0.

description.zh: 水印嵌入总时间，单位为秒，不填写默认为视频时长。
description.en: The total duration for embedding the watermark, in seconds. If unspecified, the watermark is applied to the entire video.

description.zh: 可公网访问的视频URL链接。填写后优先将其作为任务输入，其次再考虑Input输入。
description.en: A publicly accessible URL of the video. If specified, this URL is used as the job input and overrides the `Input` parameter.

description.zh: 用户自定义数据，最大长度1024字节。
description.en: User-defined data. The maximum length is 1,024 bytes.

title.zh: 提交视频版权水印作业

descriptions.zh:
- 提交视频版权水印作业默认仅支持3分钟及以上视频，视频时间过短会导致接口调用失败或无输出。如果需要对3分钟以内的短视频添加版权水印，可以通过Params参数指定，详见参数描述。

- 提交视频版权水印作业每次接口的调用，都是对独立视频进行添加水印，不支持多个视频同时提交。

- 目前数字水印相关接口只支持华东2（上海）、华北 2（北京）地域使用。更多使用限制请参见[数字水印](~~2527021#893034503fwvw~~)。

- 该接口为[异步接口](~~3027615~~)，提交任务后返回任务ID（此时任务尚未完成，任务将进入后台排队异步执行），最终结果将通过回调通知，也可通过[查询视频版权水印作业](~~2834792~~)主动查询任务状态。
descriptions.en:
- By default, copyright watermark jobs support only videos that are 3 minutes or longer. Submitting a video shorter than this duration may cause the API call to fail or produce no output. To add a copyright watermark to a short-form video (under 3 minutes), configure the `Params` parameter. For details, see the parameter description.

- Each API call processes one video.

- Currently, APIs related to digital watermark are available only in the China (Shanghai) and China (Beijing) regions. For more usage limitations, see [digital watermark](~~2527021#893034503fwvw~~).

- This is an [asynchronous API](~~3027615~~). After a job is submitted, the service returns a job ID and queues the job for background processing. The final result is delivered through a callback. You can also query the job status with the [QueryCopyrightJob](~~2834792~~) API.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mts submit-copyright-job --input Bucket_:_example-bucket_,_Location_:_oss-cn-shanghai_,_Object_:_example.mp4 --biz-output Bucket_:_example-bucket_,_Location_:_oss-cn-shanghai_,_Object_:_example_result.mp4 --message T-Head_Semiconductor --start-time 0 --total-time 10 --level 2 --description Address:_Shangke_Road,_Pudong_New_Area,_Shanghai --call-back http://example.com/callback --url http://www.example.com/video/test.mp4 --user-data 123 --params algoType_:_v2 --api-version 2014-06-18 --region cn-hangzhou
